verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical and share the same problems. The full-bleed pizza photo has been reduced to a small inset with a white border, and the orange headline band is now a separate strip floating in empty white space, so it no longer crosses the image. That loses the original's layered, immersive look and leaves large dead areas above, between and below. B sits about 20px lower, which evens out the top and bottom white space a little (A has roughly 140px at the top and 200px at the bottom), so B is marginally less lopsided.
